The quotation is specifically about consolidating multiple local councils into 5 unitary authorities in Essex, Southend-on-Sea and Thurrock — this is local government restructuring/reorganization.

The specific mechanism: merging existing district/borough/county councils into unitary councils via secondary legislation. This is squarely about the structure and organization of subnational government.

Primary: **H7** — State and Local Government • Intergovernmental Relations (restructuring of local government units)

Secondary: **R5** — Regional Government Analysis (spatial/regional dimension of the reorganization)
